episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Ga-ram risks dismissal after clashing with school staff. After, Yoon Seong-jun quits the team in protest — just before their next match.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The team takes a hit after losing their star player, forcing Ga-ram to quickly find a replacement — but when he does, he's met with resistance.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Ga-ram faces a new challenge when the school sets a trap to block his recruit's admission — a challenging test across multiple sports.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Even with a full roster, the rugby team resorts to unconventional training. But as tensions rise, their team spirit wavers — putting everything at risk.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With a tournament approaching, Ga-ram steps up to bring in a scout despite his reputation. Meanwhile, rumors of a controversy involving Bae I-ji spread.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: After Ga-ram is suddenly rushed to the hospital, I-ji learns the truth about his condition. Meanwhile, the two try to conceal the secret from the school.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The rugby team receives encouraging feedback after their Presidents Cup match. As Mun Ung struggles to tackle, his teammates try to find a solution.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: An enraging confrontation with a colleague pushes Ga-ram to throw a punch. But disciplinary action forces him to step into the other coach's role.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: As the National Sports Festival nears, Seong-jun fights through a shoulder injury — but when an unexpected visitor arrives, his troubles only deepen.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Shortly after protecting Seong-jun, Ga-ram ends up at the hospital — and his students boldly rally to defend him against those who want him gone.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Ga-ram returns to witness his team in the long-awaited finals. Can they rise above every hardship and doubt to achieve the miracle of victory?
